(1) we introduce a novel continual knowledge learning task and benchmark to measure the retention, update, and acquisition of knowledge in large language models; (2) we find that parameter expansion is necessary for continual knowledge learning; (3) we find that knowledge retention and update are two important factors in continual knowledge learning; and (4) we show that knowledge acquisition can be improved by using a simple prompt tuning approach

we introduce a new benchmark and a new metric to measure the performance of continual learning of language models, we propose several strong baselines, and we show that continual knowledge learning is a challenging and unique problem.
